title: Compress images in the browser
why_it_matters: Smaller uploads save your users' data and your storage costs.
explanation: Decode the file into a bitmap, draw it on a canvas, then export with toBlob and a lower quality value. Quality only applies to JPEG and WebP. You can also shrink width and height before drawing for bigger savings.
try_it: Compare file.size with the returned blob.size for three quality values.
